# `layout.carrier.delete`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.carrier.delete.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.carrier.delete` (`DeleteCarrier`, D6, doc 12 §3.6): deletes a carrier; the only way to delete an occupied
one.

`then` says what happens to its placements: `remove_placements` removes them; `rehome_to_surface` moves each to the
carrier's surface at the equivalent surface pose (the part keeps its place and turn, `ew_derive::layout::rehome_pose`;
EW-LAY-010 then reports a rail device off a rail). An empty carrier needs no `then`. Rejected: a carrier that does
not exist (`/carrier`); an occupied carrier without `then`; `rehome_to_surface` for a carrier that is not a valid
rail or a placement whose pose is off it. Interactive; `Bulk` above 200 placements. Outcome: none.

## Types

### CarrierThen

What `layout.carrier.delete` does with the carrier's placements (doc 12 §3.6).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"remove_placements"` | The placements are removed with the carrier. |
| `"rehome_to_surface"` | Each placement moves to the carrier's surface at the equivalent surface pose. |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
